tagline: 雅西卡旁轴相机，1963 年发布
description: 雅西卡于1963年推出的旁轴相机。配备Yashinon 1:2.8/45mm。快门速度Citizen leaf shutter with speeds from 1 sec. upto 1/500 sec.。

specs.快门: Citizen leaf shutter with speeds from 1 sec. upto 1/500 sec.
specs.曝光测光: selenium element (circle element around the lens) gives its voltage to a meter upon the camera
specs.英文简介: The Yashica Minister III was introduced in 1963, and like many cameras of the time, the meter's sensor is mounted inside the filter connection ring.
